silo_relevance: This survey is highly relevant to risk_management because it centers on methods for managing systematic risk, estimation error, and scenario uncertainty, including robust optimization, factor-based decomposition, and real-time monitoring. It also highlights practical constraints that matter for risk systems, such as data quality, computational efficiency, and the need for explainable methods under regulatory pressure.

key_points.point: Robust optimization is presented as a core risk-management tool for handling estimation error and scenario uncertainty.
key_points.silo_note: Directly relevant to risk_management because it addresses uncertainty sets, worst-case scenarios, and adaptive risk controls, which align with stress testing and resilient risk measurement.

key_points.point: Systematic risk assessment and network contagion analysis are emphasized as ways to understand how risk propagates under stress.
key_points.silo_note: This matters for risk_management because it focuses on market-wide and interconnected risks that cannot be diversified away, similar to stress and contagion analysis in risk systems.

key_points.point: Advanced factor models improve risk decomposition by capturing time-varying loadings and cross-factor interactions.
key_points.silo_note: Useful for risk_management because better decomposition supports more accurate attribution of portfolio risk and can inform factor-based risk monitoring.

key_points.point: Real-time risk monitoring and adaptive methods are highlighted as improving portfolio management capabilities.
key_points.silo_note: This is important for risk_management because monitoring and adaptation are central to timely detection and response to changing risk conditions.

key_points.point: The survey flags computational efficiency, data quality, and explainability as major constraints on deployable risk systems.
key_points.silo_note: These limitations are especially relevant to risk_management because VaR/CVaR, stress testing, and credit-risk workflows need reliable data, fast computation, and transparent outputs for operational and regulatory use.
